item.title: A collaborative session joining ESPhil’s AI Session seminar and the Open Science Community Rotterdam
item.description:
📅 14 January 2026 | 14:30-16:00 | 🏫 Glasbak

We’d like to invite all who are interested to a discussion around the stakes of migrating away from Microsoft, from philosophical and technical perspectives, and in the name of open research and academic integrity.

item.title: OSCR and ESSB organize Opening Up Science: From Principles to Practice
item.description:
📅 4 December 2025 | 14:00-15:30 | 🏫 Theil C1-6

Join us for a special meeting of the Open Science Community Rotterdam (OSCR) in collaboration with the Erasmus School of Social and Behavioural Sciences (ESSB) during which Prof. dr. Rolf Zwaan will share his extensive experience with open and responsible research practices.

item.title: OSCR and SSH-Breed organize AI for Open Science: Accelerating Discovery and Transparency
item.description:
📅 25 November 2025 | 11:00-13:00 | 🏫 Polak 1-20 | 🥗 Lunch Included

Join us for a joint meeting of the Open Science Community Rotterdam (OSCR) and SSH-Breed that brings together academics from diverse fields to explore how AI might benefit Open Science.
